headline: JAYVANG100 BENCHED THE WRONG QB TWO WEEKS IN A ROW. THIS TIME IT WAS DAK'S 44.42 🪑🤡

sections.heading: THE QUARTERBACK ROULETTE WHEEL 🎡🤡
sections.body:
Last week jayvang100 benched Brock Purdy (29.28) to start Dak Prescott (23.50) and lost by 3.98. So this week the lesson was learned: Purdy in, Dak out. Dak Prescott scored 44.42. On the bench. LOL. 😭

Purdy was hardly a bust at 37.66, and George Pickens went for 38.00 at flex, so jayvang100 still dropped the week's high score, 144.86, and beat ChunckyM by 22.27. But with Dak in there it's 151.62. Two weeks, two QB coin flips, two wrong calls. The good news is there are only two quarterbacks on that roster, so next week it's statistically impossible to... no, actually, it's 50/50 again. 🪙🪙

sections.heading: HVANG94: 13TH OF 14 AND ALONE IN FIRST PLACE 🍀🏆
sections.body:
Hvang94 scored 83.97, the second-worst score of the week. That number beats exactly one team in the league. Luckily, that one team was the opponent. muahuavang put up 77.75 and Hvang94 won by 6.22 to go 8-2, now alone at the top of the standings. 🫠

Drake Maye scored 3.02. Three. Jordyn Tyson put up 13.50 on the bench while Devaughn Vele started and did 2.40. Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.80) carried the whole thing on his back. Hvang94 has now won with a negative defense, won with NO defense, and won with a 3-point quarterback. At this point the schedule maker should be under investigation. 🕵️

sections.heading: MAHOMES 45.42, AND MOUAVANG86 STILL LOST 💀
sections.body:
Patrick Mahomes dropped 45.42, the best score any starter put up all week. mouavang86 lost to cvang1990 anyway, 109.17 to 104.22. 😩

The supporting cast: Jalen Coker 0.30, Audric Estime 1.60, Chris Boswell 5.00. Braelon Allen scored 5.10 on the bench, which still wouldn't have saved it. Swap him in and mouavang86 loses by 1.45 instead. 44% of the team's points came from one guy, and the other eight forgot it was game day.

On the other side, cvang1990 picked up Geno Smith this week and started him for 5.92. Lamar Jackson is on IR, so the QB slot is still haunted 👻, but Chuba Hubbard (31.70), Isaiah Likely (23.20) and Cam Little, the week's top kicker at 19.00, exorcised it just enough.

sections.heading: THE BLOWOUT: YMVTHEDAD 129.31, IMBACKBEECH 102.87 💥
sections.body:
Joe Burrow scored 41.16 and Jahmyr Gibbs 40.70. That's 81.86 from two guys, 63% of the team. YMVtheDAD won by 26.44, the week's biggest margin, and moved to 7-3 with the most points for in the league (1168.76). 🔥

And YMVtheDAD still started Omar Cooper Jr. for 0.00 with Antonio Williams scoring 11.20 on the bench. Last week he scored 9.80 on the bench. This week he started and scored zero. Omar Cooper Jr. is a fantasy reverse-jinx and somebody needs to tell YMVtheDAD. 🧿

imbackbeech is now on a five-game losing streak. Ja'Marr Chase (28.60) and Jared Goff (26.42) did their jobs, but Aaron Jones Sr. scored 12.00 on the bench while Travis Etienne Jr. started for 4.90. 3-7 and sinking. 🛟

sections.heading: THE NAIL-BITER: TUB89 GETS PAST THE BOOKIE BY 3.26 😅
sections.body:
Tub89 beat Evz132 122.49 to 119.23, the closest game of the week. Emmett Johnson went off for 32.10 at flex and C.J. Stroud added 26.44. That's four straight wins and a 7-3 record. 💪

The bookie had Jordan Love (12.80) on the bench behind Tyler Shough (11.98). That swap is worth 0.82. They lost by 3.26. For once Evz132 can't blame the lineup, just the house odds. Deebo Samuel Sr. (24.40) and the Rams D (14.15) did all they could. 🎰

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH: THE DEFENSE CAROUSEL SPINS AGAIN 🎠
sections.body:
Tonglue picked up the Ravens defense on Wednesday, then dropped them Thursday for the 49ers. Tub89 grabbed the Ravens on waivers Friday. Ravens: 4.45. 49ers: 1.25. Tonglue lost by 8.31. LOL. 🔄

To grab those Ravens, Tub89 cut the Bengals defense. muahuavang claimed the Bengals right after, and they scored 6.45. So the D that Tub89 threw away outscored the one it got. Tub89 won anyway, so nobody's complaining except the Ravens' stat sheet. 🙃

The best pickups came from YMVtheDAD, who added the Lions D (14.75) and kicker Ryan Fitzgerald (11.00, picked up Sunday morning) as free agents. And imbackbeech's free-agent Colts D did 16.65, the second-best defense of the week. It just wasn't enough. Top defense honors go to VangMushu's Vikings at 21.50. 🛡️

sections.heading: THE STANDINGS: SIX PLAYOFF SPOTS, FOUR WEEKS LEFT 🏁
sections.body:
Hvang94 (8-2) is alone in first. Then three teams at 7-3: YMVtheDAD (1168.76 PF), ChunckyM (1163.36) and Tub89 (1077.16). cvang1990 (1101.87) and KevinVang (1053.51) are 6-4 and hold the last two playoff spots. 🎟️

The first team out is jayvang100 at 5-5, with the second-most points in the league (1143.68). Nobody is going to want to see that team in the bracket, and two weeks of bad QB picks are the only reason they might miss it. mouavang86 and Evz132 are also 5-5. 😬

Down in the basement, four teams sit at 3-7 (imbackbeech, Tonglue, Keeneng, VangMushu), and muahuavang is alone at 2-8 after a fifth straight loss. 🏚️

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
1. jayvang100 — 144.86, won by 22.27. Brock Purdy (37.66) and George Pickens (38.00) powered the week's high score. Dak Prescott scored 44.42 on the bench, which is the second week in a row jayvang100 picked the wrong quarterback. 🪑

2. YMVtheDAD — 129.31, won by 26.44. Joe Burrow (41.16) and Jahmyr Gibbs (40.70) built the week's biggest blowout. Omar Cooper Jr. started and scored 0.00 while Antonio Williams did 11.20 on the bench. 🧿

3. ChunckyM — 122.59, LOST by 22.27. The third-best score in the league, beats 11 teams, ran into the one team that had a week-high. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (27.10) and Parker Washington (24.70) showed up, Brock Bowers (2.80) and Chris Rodriguez Jr. (0.50) did not. 📉

4. Tub89 — 122.49, won by 3.26. Emmett Johnson's 32.10 at flex was the difference in the week's closest game. Four straight wins, even after cutting the Bengals D, who then scored 6.45 for someone else. 🔥

5. KevinVang — 121.68, won by 8.31. Christian McCaffrey ran for 44.30 and Stefon Diggs added 17.30. Tre Tucker scored 1.40 in a starting WR slot, so CMC basically played two positions. 🐐

6. Evz132 — 119.23, LOST by 3.26. Deebo Samuel Sr. (24.40) and the Rams D (14.15) kept it close. Tyler Shough (11.98) started over Jordan Love (12.80), which cost 0.82, and the house still lost by 3.26. 🎰

7. Tonglue — 113.37, LOST by 8.31. Cam Skattebo (25.70) and new pickup J.J. McCarthy (19.12) were solid. But Tucker Kraft started for 2.40 while Brenton Strange did 7.90 on the bench, and the 49ers D Tonglue swapped in scored 1.25. 🔄

8. VangMushu — 113.16, won by 24.53. The Vikings D led the league with 21.50, Jayden Daniels did 26.76, and Chase Brown 24.30. That's two wins in a row, while all six bench players scored 0.00, so there wasn't even a wrong decision to make. 🛡️

9. cvang1990 — 109.17, won by 4.95. Chuba Hubbard (31.70), Isaiah Likely (23.20) and Cam Little (19.00, the week's top kicker) carried it. New QB Geno Smith did 5.92, and Harold Fannin Jr. scored 12.60 on the bench. 👻

10. mouavang86 — 104.22, LOST by 4.95. Patrick Mahomes scored 45.42, the most by any starter this week, and it still wasn't enough. Jalen Coker (0.30) and Audric Estime (1.60) made sure of that. 💀

11. imbackbeech — 102.87, LOST by 26.44. Ja'Marr Chase (28.60) and the free-agent Colts D (16.65) were great. Aaron Jones Sr. scored 12.00 on the bench while Travis Etienne Jr. started for 4.90, and the losing streak is now five. 🛟

12. Keeneng — 88.63, LOST by 24.53. Picking Trevor Lawrence (32.78) over Matthew Stafford (25.76) was the right call. Then Jason Myers kicked 2.00 and DeMario Douglas caught 0.90, and Justice Hill scored 6.30 on the bench while the new pickup Tutu Atwell did 3.60 at flex. 🦵

13. Hvang94 — 83.97, won by 6.22. Drake Maye scored 3.02, Jordyn Tyson put up 13.50 on the bench, and Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.80) still dragged this team to 8-2 and first place. Luck isn't a strategy, but it's working great. 🍀

14. muahuavang — 77.75, LOST by 6.22. Nico Collins (19.90) and Omarion Hampton (17.00) tried. Malik Nabers (4.90) and Travis Kelce (4.00) didn't, and muahuavang lost to the only other team under 85. Five straight losses. 🪦
